$comment: Fleet Tasks spec-fidelity machine-readable requirement registry (methodology pillar 1). Canon: design/tasks-req-registry.yaml (50 REQs). Annotation form is the bracketed [REQ-NNN] (3-digit). implementation_file/symbol and test pointers were derived by grepping the live [REQ-NNN] annotations in claw-fleet-task/src, claw-fleet-core/src, fleet-task/src. REQs without code annotations carry implementation_file=null and status=infrastructure|pending; see orphan_reqs in the verify report.

requirements.title: P-item 9 atomic fields
requirements.description: P-item 数据结构支持 9 个原子字段：id, desc, depends_on, touches, resources, estimate_secs, acceptance, artifacts, skippable, human_gate, status
requirements.acceptance: 结构体定义包含全部 9 字段 + 各字段有 Serialize/Deserialize; 所有字段无 Option 包装（必填）; 单元测试验证字段序列化/反序列化往返一致

requirements.title: DagPlan container + deterministic node_ids + validate
requirements.description: DagPlan 容器实现不可变 HashMap<PItemId, PItem> 及其访问器，支持确定性 node_ids() 迭代
requirements.acceptance: get/get_mut/len 三个基础方法存在；node_ids() 按字典序或创建顺序返回，测试验证确定性；validate() 检查引用完整性和无环性

requirements.title: Acceptance audit forbids proxy signals
requirements.description: Acceptance Audit Protocol 禁止使用代理信号（worker 自报、token 消耗、diff 大小、耗时）来判定 P-item 完成状态
requirements.acceptance: Master SYSTEM template 明确列举 4 个禁止信号及其理由; mark-done 前代码显式枚举待检查的 acceptance criteria; 单元测试用仅含代理信号的 mock 输入→must fail，用 builds-pass→must succeed
requirements.implementation_symbol: system_template.md proxy-signal section; enforced in actions.rs mark_done + auditor/mod.rs

requirements.title: Master full 4-step acceptance audit protocol
requirements.description: Master 必须执行完整的 Acceptance Audit Protocol：枚举声明的验收条件、逐个查证、禁止代理信号、不确定时返回 worker 或问用户
requirements.acceptance: SYSTEM template 定义 4-step 流程（unpack→find evidence→forbid proxies→escalate）; 每个 P-item 状态转移到 Done 前 trace log 显示审计步骤; unit test: TestsPass 条件缺失→mark-done 拒绝; HumanReview 条件→AskUserQuestion

requirements.title: touches enforcement via Edit/Write hook
requirements.description: P-item.touches 字段强制声明该 P-item 被编辑的所有相对路径，运行时 Edit/Write 工具调用被 hook 拦截并检查是否在 touches 范围内
requirements.acceptance: Touches 作为 Vec<PathBuf>; 每个 Edit/Write 调用触发 check_path_against_touches(); 路径不在范围→SIGSTOP worker 并记录 TouchesViolationMarker; unit test: touches=['src/foo/']，试图写 src/bar/→must block

requirements.title: mark-done checks each declared acceptance criterion in order
requirements.description: 当 Master 决定 mark-done 时，必须显式检查 P-item.acceptance 中列举的每一个验收条件，按声明顺序逐个查证证据
requirements.acceptance: acceptance criteria enum variants 各有 1+ criteria; mark-done 代码显式遍历并 check each; 若某条不通过→返回 Failed 或问用户; test: 声明 [Builds, TestsPass]，仅 Builds 通过→mark-done 拒绝

requirements.title: propagate_skip records reason/timestamp/session
requirements.description: DagPlan.propagate_skip() 必须记录每个被跳过的 P-item 的决策原因、时间戳和触发者，以供偏差账本追踪
requirements.acceptance: propagate_skip 返回的每个 skip 记录包含 (p_item_id, skip_reason, skipped_at_timestamp, skipped_by_session_id); 偏差账本可查询哪些 P-item 因 upstream 失败被自动跳过; test: 上游 Failed→downstream Skipped，查偏差账本能追踪原因

requirements.title: P-item state transitions record timestamp + REQ source
requirements.description: 所有运行时的 P-item 状态转移必须记录时间戳和关联的 REQ 源头
requirements.acceptance: task-audit log 包含每个状态转移的 (p_item_id, from_status, to_status, timestamp, triggered_by_req_id); 用户可查询某 P-item 何时进入哪个状态及原因; test: dispatch_next_pitem 记录时间戳，mark_done 记录完成时刻
requirements.implementation_symbol: StateTransition / TransitionTrigger / append_transition; plan.rs records skip trigger=REQ-007

requirements.title: TouchesViolationMarker append-only ledger
requirements.description: TouchesViolationMarker append-only 日志必须在 ~/.fleet/touches-violations/ 中原子性写入，不允许覆盖或删除，仅允许 supervisor 定期 drain
requirements.acceptance: record_violation() 写入唯一命名的 JSON 文件（无覆盖）; drain_violations() 按 recorded_at 排序返回所有条目然后删除; 若写入失败→记录 error 但不 panic; test: 写 10 个 violation，drain 返回 10 个且有序

requirements.title: Master 10 red lines embedded in SYSTEM template
requirements.description: Master 红线清单共 10 条，编译期嵌入 SYSTEM template 中
requirements.acceptance: include_str!() 嵌入 system_template.md 中明确列举 10 条红线; 代码中有 10 个对应的 #[test] 验证每条红线被 template 提及; docstring 中说明每条的制裁

requirements.title: human_gate routes to WaitHumanGate
requirements.description: Master 检查 P-item.human_gate 字段：若为 true，审计通过后必须进入 WaitHumanGate 状态，调用 AskUserQuestion，等用户回复后才 mark-done
requirements.acceptance: status=WaitHumanGate 存在于 PItemStatus enum; mark-done 前检查 human_gate 字段; test: human_gate=true→mark-done 返回 WaitHumanGate 状态，不直接 Done
requirements.implementation_symbol: audit_acceptance gate precedence; PItemStatus::WaitHumanGate in pitem.rs

requirements.title: AcceptanceCriterion enum 4 variants
requirements.description: P-item.acceptance 字段使用 enum 表示 4 种验证法：Builds、TestsPass(cmd)、HumanReview、Custom(rule)，Master 必须按声明顺序逐条检查
requirements.acceptance: enum AcceptanceCriterion { Builds, TestsPass(String), HumanReview, Custom(String) } 定义存在; pitem.rs 有 serialize/deserialize test; mark-done 遍历 acceptance[*] 并检查每一个

requirements.title: output_summary 50-200 chars + artifact kind
requirements.description: Worker 必须在 P-item 完成后写入 output_summary，内容 50-200 字、标记为 artifact kind，供下游 P-item 的 Layer 3 context 注入
requirements.acceptance: output_summary field 存在于 mark-done API 参数; 字数检查：<50 warn，>200 truncate; artifact kind (FileList|GitDiff|TestOutput|ManualNote) 必选

requirements.title: unblocked_items returns ready WaitDeps nodes
requirements.description: DagPlan.unblocked_items() 必须返回所有 status=WaitDeps 且其 depends_on 中所有 P-item 都已 terminal 的节点
requirements.acceptance: 算法遍历 WaitDeps 节点检查 depends_on 全 terminal; 返回集有序; test: 3 个节点 1←2, 1←3，1 Done 后解除对 2 的阻塞

requirements.title: resource_conflicts detects competing pairs
requirements.description: DagPlan.resource_conflicts() 必须检测所有竞争同一资源的 P-item 对，返回无重复的 ResourceConflict 集
requirements.acceptance: 对每个 resource 找所有声明者; 组合所有对 i<j; 去重; 返回 Vec<ResourceConflict> 有序; test: P1[build], P2[build], P3[git]→返回 (P1,P2)

requirements.title: WorkerSpawnSpec 5 mandatory fields
requirements.description: WorkerSpawnSpec 必须包含 5 个字段：task_id, p_item_id, cwd, system_prompt, model
requirements.acceptance: struct WorkerSpawnSpec 定义; 无 Option 字段（都必填）; Serialize/Deserialize 实现

requirements.title: compose_worker_system_prompt assembles 3 layers in order
requirements.description: compose_worker_system_prompt() 必须按顺序组装 3 层 context：Layer 1 / Layer 2 / Layer 3，每层之间用清晰的 markdown 分隔符
requirements.acceptance: 函数调用 compose_layer1 + compose_layer2 + compose_layer3 按序连接; 每层间有 '## Layer N' 标题; test: 返回包含 3 个标题的字符串

requirements.title: Layer 1 project constants + execution constraints
requirements.description: Layer 1 必须包含项目常数和执行约束：touches-only, SIGSTOP, no manual commit, summary-only
requirements.acceptance: compose_layer1 输出包含 architecture.md 的 render_layer1_block 结果; 显式声明 3 条约束; test: 约束文本出现在 system prompt 中

requirements.title: Layer 2 task data wrapped in <untrusted_*>
requirements.description: Layer 2 必须包含 task 的 title、description、inbox materials (用 <untrusted_*> 包装)，以及 acceptance criteria 摘要
requirements.acceptance: compose_layer2 包含 Task.title/description; 每个 Material 渲染为 <untrusted_file>/<untrusted_text>; 列出 task 级 acceptance; test: 包含 <untrusted_*>

requirements.title: Layer 3 P-item spec + upstream summaries + output demand
requirements.description: Layer 3 必须包含 P-item 的 desc, touches list, acceptance criteria, upstream output_summary，并明确要求 worker 输出 output_summary
requirements.acceptance: compose_layer3 包含 desc/touches/acceptance/每个 depends_on 的 upstream output_summary; 末尾有写 output_summary 指令; test: 返回包含 touches 文件列表和上游摘要的字符串

requirements.title: Master uses only 7 task tools, git/edit forbidden
requirements.description: Master 必须仅通过专用工具（dispatch/mark-done/mark-failed/update-plan）与 task 交互，不允许直接修改 task.json 或调用 git 命令
requirements.acceptance: SYSTEM template 明确列举 7 个允许工具，显式禁止 git/edit/write/pause/resume/clear; test: 工具段列 7 个允许，git/edit/write/pause/resume/clear 被点名禁止

requirements.title: Auditor independent of Master, deterministic red-line rules
requirements.description: Auditor 必须独立于 Master，用确定性规则（非 LLM 投票）检查 10 条红线的违反，并生成结构化的 violation report。每次 mark-done 在 merge 前过这层规则门。[WA-DEC: 5184d39 砸掉 3-session LLM 投票 quorum，改纯规则 + mark_done 硬门]
requirements.acceptance: Auditor 在进程内对 mark-done 跑确定性规则（audit_mark_done proxy 信号检测 + audit_pitem_diff 弱实现/红线检测）; 产生 findings {severity, category, finding, evidence, req_affected}; 红线/Critical finding → mark_done 返回 Err(AUDIT_CRITICAL) 绝不 merge; findings 写 ~/.fleet/audits/; 无任何 LLM 投票/quorum; test: 红线/proxy-only 违反→Critical 且阻断 merge
requirements.implementation_symbol: audit_mark_done + audit_pitem_diff 确定性规则 + 10 条红线 canonical set; mark_done 硬门见 actions.rs

requirements.title: Requirement registry req.json
requirements.description: 需求注册表（req.json）必须存储所有 REQ-NNN 原子化条目，包括 id, title, description, acceptance_criteria, implementation_file, test_file, status, deviation_reason, deviation_approved_by
requirements.acceptance: req.json 存在; 每个 REQ 有至少 8 个字段; 所有 implementation_file 都能 grep 出 [REQ-NNN] 标记; CI 脚本报告未实现的 REQ
tests: verify_req_annotations.sh (cross-checks req.json ids vs code annotations)

requirements.title: Traceability matrix REQ -> impl -> test
requirements.description: 可追溯矩阵必须建立 REQ-NNN → src/file:line → test/func 的双向映射，CI 脚本自动验证覆盖率
requirements.acceptance: traceability.md 含表格 REQ | implementation | test | status; 代码中所有 implementation 都有 [REQ-NNN] 注释; grep 结果与 req.json id 列表匹配（无孤立代码、无孤立 REQ）

requirements.title: Deviation ledger append-only deviations.jsonl
requirements.description: 偏差账本（deviations.jsonl）必须是 append-only 日志，记录每一个不符合 spec 的决策
requirements.acceptance: deviations.jsonl 存在; 每行一个 JSON 对象按时间排序; 无追溯修改; 每条有人工 approved_by 签名; 若 status != approved，master 应拒绝对应 P-item 的 done

requirements.title: Worker declares simplification in output_summary
requirements.description: 当 Worker 无法完全满足需求时，必须主动在 output_summary 中声明「简化」的原因、影响的 REQ
requirements.acceptance: output_summary 含 '简化声明' 或 '[DEVIATION]' 标记，Master 解析并创建 deviations.jsonl 条目; 条目含 affected_req 列表和 mitigation

requirements.title: mark-done blocks on pending deviations
requirements.description: Master 必须在 mark-done 前检查是否存在未批准的偏差（status=pending），若有则询问用户是否继续
requirements.acceptance: mark-done 前查询 deviations.jsonl; 过滤 affected_req 相关且 status != approved 的条目; 若找到→AskUserQuestion 或返回 Failed

requirements.title: Auditor weak-implementation heuristics
requirements.description: Auditor 必须检测「比 spec 弱」的实现模式：acceptance 强度下降、touches 范围缩小、dependency 链断开、resource 占用异常
requirements.acceptance: Auditor SYSTEM prompt 含 4 个「弱」模式检测; 每个有具体 heuristic; 生成 weakness_report; 仅报告不修复

requirements.title: merge_back 3 outcomes
requirements.description: merge_back() 必须支持 3 种 outcome：FastForwarded、AutoMerged、Conflict
requirements.acceptance: MergeOutcome enum 有 3 个 variant; Conflict case 含 ConflictSpec vec; 无递归重试; test: 线性→FastForwarded, 并行改同文件→Conflict

requirements.title: merge_mediator LLM per conflict file with <resolved> contract
requirements.description: merge_mediator 必须对每个冲突文件调用 LLM，用固定 prompt 模板，要求输出 <resolved>...</resolved> 包装，拒绝含 conflict marker 的输出
requirements.acceptance: render_prompt 填充 MEDIATOR_PROMPT_TEMPLATE; mediate_one 调用 LLM 解析响应; extract_resolved 检查 <resolved>; 发现 marker→MarkersLeftBehind error

requirements.title: MEDIATOR_PROMPT_TEMPLATE encodes 4 heuristics
requirements.description: MEDIATOR_PROMPT_TEMPLATE 必须包含明确指令：保留非冲突改动、favor THEIRS、不留 marker、用 <resolved> 包装
requirements.acceptance: template 含 4+ 条英文指令; test: THEIRS 倾向 + marker cleanup

requirements.title: WorkerExecutor post-completion cargo check
requirements.description: WorkerExecutor 在完成后必须运行 cargo check，检查 touches 中涉及的 Rust crates，失败→记录但不自动 fail P-item
requirements.acceptance: run_post_completion_check() 走遍 touches 找 Cargo.toml 对每 crate cargo check --package; 返回 PostCompletionCheck struct; 非 fatal
tests: (covered by worker.rs module tests; post-completion check exercised via run_post_completion_check)

requirements.title: audit-patterns.json >= 25 rules in 3 levels
requirements.description: Audit 模式文件（audit-patterns.json）必须包含至少 25 个预定义的审计规则，分为 critical/high/medium 三档。规则集由 claw-fleet-core/src/audit.rs 的 builtin_patterns/builtin_python_patterns 定义并经 get_patterns 加载（audit-patterns.json 为 shipped 副本，~/.fleet/fleet-audit-patterns.json 为用户覆盖）
requirements.acceptance: audit-patterns.json 存在且 patterns array >=25 条，每条有 {level, tag, match_mode, patterns, descriptions}; builtin 规则集 >=25 条且 level 覆盖 critical/high/medium 三档; level 仅限 critical/high/medium
requirements.implementation_symbol: builtin_patterns + builtin_python_patterns + get_patterns (audit-patterns.json 规则集加载)

requirements.title: AuditEvent struct + dedup_key
requirements.description: 运行时 audit 事件必须被记录为 AuditEvent 结构，去重 key 为 session|timestamp|tool
requirements.acceptance: AuditEvent struct 含 7+ 字段; dedup_key() 返回 session_id|timestamp|tool_name; 事件由 extract_audit_events 从历史重建

requirements.title: Whitelist rules require human signature
requirements.description: User Audit Rules（白名单）必须删除或改为 require explicit master approval，不允许静默绕过 critical audit signals
requirements.acceptance: 若保留白名单，每条必须记录到 deviations.jsonl 并需人工签署; 或直接删除 UserAuditRules; test: sudo 白名单→仍被报告/需签

requirements.title: Out-of-touches edit triggers violation marker + SIGSTOP
requirements.description: 任何超出 P-item.touches 的文件修改尝试必须触发 TouchesViolationMarker 记录（via SIGSTOP hook），Master 决定补充/拒绝/升级
requirements.acceptance: Edit/Write hook check_path_against_touches；路径不在→record_violation + SIGSTOP; 偏差账本可查询; Master 有 3 种选择

requirements.title: SYSTEM template include_str!, override debug-only
requirements.description: Master 的 SYSTEM template 必须以 include_str!() 编译期嵌入；开发环境可用 FLEET_MASTER_SYSTEM_TEMPLATE_OVERRIDE 逃生口但仅 debug build
requirements.acceptance: include_str!('system_template.md'); template_source() 检查 env 仅在 cfg!(debug_assertions); release 无逃生口; test: debug 可覆盖，release ignore env

requirements.title: output_summary feeds downstream Layer 3
requirements.description: Worker 完成后写出 output_summary（50-200 字，artifact kind），供下游 P-item Layer 3 context 注入
requirements.acceptance: mark-done API 接受 output_summary; 字数检查; 必须指定 artifact_kind; 下游 compose_layer3 含 '依赖 <id> 的摘要：<summary>'

requirements.title: Persisted state-transition history with trigger
requirements.description: 任何 P-item 状态转移必须记录到持久化日志，包含 timestamp, from_status, to_status, triggered_by
requirements.acceptance: task-audit.jsonl 含状态转移历史; 每条 (p_item_id, from, to, ts, trigger); 用户查询 P-item 历史→显示转移链
requirements.implementation_symbol: StateTransition / read_transitions / append_transitions; plan.rs persists skip transition

requirements.title: provision creates worktree isolation
requirements.description: provision() 必须为每个 P-item 创建 worktree isolation 环境（git worktree add）；merge_back() 和 reap() 管理生命周期
requirements.acceptance: provision 调用 git worktree add; 已存在→检查孤立可清理; 返回路径; merge_back 3-way; reap worktree remove

requirements.title: Merge commits carry fleet identification
requirements.description: 所有 merge commits 必须包含识别信息（如 'fleet: merged P-item <id> from <worker_session>'）
requirements.acceptance: finish_merge_commit() 含描述; msg 格式 'fleet: merged <p_item_id> from session <sid> worker <worker_id>'; git log grep fleet 可见

requirements.title: Master records dispatch + mark-done decisions
requirements.description: Master 必须记录每一个 dispatch_pitem 和 mark-done 的决策，包括决策时刻、affected P-item、acceptance 验证结果、偏差是否记录
requirements.acceptance: Master 运行日志含 dispatch/mark-done 事件 + acceptance 结果; 若有偏差→日志含偏差 id; Auditor 可回放
requirements.implementation_symbol: structured MasterDecision log (append-only JSONL) in mark_done/mark_failed

requirements.title: Auditor verifies acceptance, rejects proxy-only
requirements.description: Auditor 必须检查每个 mark-done 的 acceptance criteria 是否真的被验证，禁止仅用 proxy signal 通过验证
requirements.acceptance: Auditor 查 mark-done 事件的 acceptance 列表反查实质证据; 仅有 token/time→报告 critical (REQ-003/004 违反); test: proxy-only→Auditor rejects

requirements.title: All REQ implementations carry [REQ-NNN] annotation
requirements.description: 所有 REQ-NNN 的实现必须在代码中用 [REQ-NNN] 注释标注，Auditor 用 grep 反向追踪实现与注册表的一致性
requirements.acceptance: 代码中每个 REQ 的实现位置都有 // [REQ-NNN] 注释; grep 能找到所有实现; CI 脚本检查代码 [REQ-NNN] 集合 == registry id 集合（无孤立代码、无孤立 REQ）
requirements.implementation_symbol: annotation-consistency CI check (registry infrastructure, P12). The annotations themselves live across all src/ files.
tests: verify_req_annotations.sh (self-checking: runs the grep vs registry comparison)

requirements.title: CI spec-fidelity gate
requirements.description: CI 流程必须在每次提交前运行 spec-fidelity 检查：验证 req.json integrity，检查覆盖率，检查偏差账本批准状态，运行 Auditor 检查
requirements.acceptance: CI script 运行 3 个子检查：req.json valid 且所有 REQ 有实现/test 或在 deviations approved; 代码 annotations 与 registry 一致; Auditor critical=0
requirements.implementation_symbol: scripts/verify_req_annotations.sh implements sub-check #2 (annotation<->registry consistency). The full 3-in-1 check_spec_fidelity.sh wrapper is not yet built.

requirements.title: architecture.md project-level Layer 1 store
requirements.description: architecture.md 必须存储在 ~/.fleet/projects/<project_id>/architecture.md，作为 Layer 1 的项目级常数
requirements.acceptance: path 存在; load_for_project 读取渲染为 Layer 1 block; render_layer1_block() 返回 markdown; test: 加 architecture.md→worker context 含其内容

requirements.title: fleet.yaml phases + custom resource locks
requirements.description: fleet.yaml 配置文件必须支持 phases{cmd, resources} 和 resources{custom_locks}，供 Planner 和 Scheduler 使用
requirements.acceptance: fleet.yaml 含 phases + resources custom_X concurrency; load_fleet_config 解析验证; test: custom:db 资源→scheduler 检测避免冲突
requirements.implementation_symbol: load_fleet_config / FleetConfig / validate_plan_resources; scheduling in runner.rs

requirements.title: skippable SkipCondition NoChangesIn/Custom
requirements.description: P-item 的 skippable 字段支持两种跳过条件：NoChangesIn(paths) 自动检查 git diff，Custom(rule) 由 worker 评估
requirements.acceptance: enum SkipCondition { NoChangesIn(Vec<PathBuf>), Custom(String) }; NoChangesIn 触发 git diff 无改动→auto-skip; Master 记录每个 auto-skip

requirements.title: Scheduler enforces resource exclusion
requirements.description: 任何 P-item 的 resources 声明必须被 Scheduler 检查，竞争同一 resource 的 P-item 不能并发执行
requirements.acceptance: P-item.resources Vec<String>; Scheduler.resource_conflicts() 检测; 有冲突→不能并发; test: P1[build],P2[build],P3[git]→P1,P2 串行，P3 可并行
requirements.implementation_symbol: resource_conflicts (consumed by scheduler); PItem.resources in pitem.rs

requirements.title: mark-done explicit acceptance audit, no implicit skip
requirements.description: Master 必须在标记 P-item 为 Done 前显式调用 acceptance audit 逻辑，不允许隐含跳过或由 worker 自报状态
requirements.acceptance: mark-done: 查 acceptance criteria→逐条调用验证函数→全过 Done / 任一失败 Failed / 不确定问用户; 代码可观察 4 步; test: [Builds,TestsPass] 仅 Builds 过→拒绝
